summary: Frontend-only verification of the two new right-sidebar features (Divider 'Auto-Match Color' and Shape 'Save My Preset') plus divider snap + built-in preset regression. All specified behaviours verified working end-to-end with zero console errors.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: Large Header block added to canvas; localStorage key 'webdojo_shape_presets' written and then cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 16 verified:

1) Divider Auto-Match Color (data-testid='divider-match-color'):
   - Button is DISABLED before any canvas selection (hasSel guard in DividerPanel).
   - After double-clicking 'Large Header' (block-cmp-header-lrg, solid #ffffff background) and selecting the canvas element, the button becomes enabled.
   - Clicking the button: divider-color-hex updated from default '#6366f1' -> '#ffffff' (picked up the header's real bg). Toast 'Matched divider fill to the section background' shown via sonner.
   - matchSectionColor() correctly walks node + descendants, reads getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor, and rgbToHex converts.

2) Divider snap regression: divider-place-below + divider-insert inserts a new canvas-el (count 1 -> 2). Prior iteration_15 already covered above/end.

3) Shape 'Save My Preset':
   - Typed 'MyGlow' into shape-preset-name, clicked shape-save-preset with shape-corner-squircle + shape-radius-all=40 + shape-shadow-glow active.
   - Toast 'Saved preset "MyGlow"' shown. A new chip appeared: data-testid 'shape-preset-custom-<ts>' with label 'MyGlow'.
   - localStorage['webdojo_shape_presets'] persisted the array with id/custom/patch{border, border-radius, corner-shape, box-shadow}.
   - Clicking the custom chip on a selected canvas element patched the first descendant's inline style with corner-shape, box-shadow, border-radius (toast 'Applied ...').
   - Delete button 'shape-preset-delete-custom-<ts>' removes chip (visible via group-hover:opacity-100; clicked with force=True to bypass hover requirement). After delete, no custom chips remain.
   - Persistence: saved 'PersistMe', reloaded the page, localStorage retained the entry and the chip re-rendered.

4) Built-in preset regression: shape-preset-glass still applies (canvas-el innerHTML contains 'backdrop-filter').

No console errors captured across the full run.

Minor UX note (report-only, non-blocking): the custom-preset delete X-button is only visible on group-hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100) — mouse users will discover it, but touch/keyboard users cannot reveal it. Consider making it always visible (or focus-visible) for a11y. This is pre-existing and does not affect the specified behaviour.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - all features work as specified.
